title: Grateful Dead Live at Avalon Ballroom on 1969-04-04

ai_review.summary: Flat‑ish soundboard with volume swings but a smoking Dark Star makes this ’69 show worth the listen
ai_review.review: The recording is a soundboard capture that suffers from inconsistent levels – sometimes inaudible, other times blaring – and an odd 12‑second drum solo split off as its own track. Musically the highlight is an open, fast‑paced Dark Star that fans describe as “on fire,” with the rest of the set judged as a fairly typical 1969 performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise the Dark Star and overall energy (high show weight), while several note flat, uneven soundboard quality (lower recording weight). The blend yields a solid above‑average rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Volume fluctuates from inaudible to blaring; described as flat soundboard. A 12‑second drum solo is split into its own track, which some find odd.

standout_songs: That's It For The Other One
show_quality.setlist_flow: Limited commentary on overall flow; reviewers focus on the Dark Star as the peak moment of a typical ’69 set.

band_member_comments.Phil: Humorously noted ('Phil farts') indicating his presence and contribution during the show.
band_member_comments.Drums: A short (12‑second) drum solo was isolated as a separate track, drawing attention from reviewers.
